items.title: AI Agents Gone Rogue

body.query: What are the documented failure modes of autonomous AI coding agents at scale: reward hacking or test tampering, review rubber-stamping, regressions introduced by fixes, runaway token spend, and merge conflicts in high-volume repos? How do organizations mitigate them?
